title: ProVIDE Studies Post Exit Analysis
summary: A study to collect data on the post-study exit incidence of secondary reintervention using alternate surgical LUTS therapy.
conditions: BPH With Symptomatic Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 1\. US based subjects previously enrolled in the ProVIDE Study or the ProVIDE II Bridging Study who had a ProVee device removed.
* 2\. Subjects who withdrew consent or were withdrawn by site Study PI.
* 3\. Subjects consented to make data available.

Exclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Incomplete records available.
* 2\. Subjects who exited the studies due to restarting BPH medication while they were enrolled.
* 3\. Subjects who did not receive a ProVee in the ProVIDE Study or the ProVIDE II Bridging Study.
* 4\. Subjects who exited the studies due to prostate cancer.
